title: French Braised Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty French-inspired stew made with tender cabbage and a rich, flavorful broth.
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the cabbage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the cabbage is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon butter and season with salt.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
